cues: Wisdom also needs awareness of the ends of human life: what life is for.
Many historians did harm because they saw facts through their own passions.
Hegel's philosophy of history was certainly comprehensive, yet its chief lesson was that Germany had been the leading nation since four hundred A D.
So wisdom includes feeling: men whose knowledge is wide but whose feelings are narrow lack what Russell calls wisdom.
text: But comprehensiveness is not enough. Wisdom also needs awareness of the ends of human life: what life is for. Many historians did harm because they saw facts through their own passions. Hegel's philosophy of history was certainly comprehensive, yet its chief lesson was that Germany had been the leading nation since four hundred A D. So wisdom includes feeling: men whose knowledge is wide but whose feelings are narrow lack what Russell calls wisdom.
